steps.content: [Insert an eerie, grand sound effect] The Black Ring flickers for a moment
Inside the partially enclosed, highly contaminated maze, the opposing sides maintain a certain distance.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: We were too idealistic. Killing Parma and destroying the sorcery didn't stop the contamination and the Mania keeps worsening. In the worst case, we might have fallen into the Underground's trap. They've set up a decoy to distract us or exhaust our time and energy.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: We don't have much time to waste. We must rethink our strategy. There's not much we can do, so I'll be upfront.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: Mr. Donald, do you know where Chief ${PlayerName} is?
The FAC soldiers aren't pointing their guns at Donald, but they don't lower them either.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Are you suspecting me? Hey, don't I have a guarantor from Paradeisos? What, doesn't the FAC trust Hush?

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: According to Hush, she's vouched for a powerful S-Class Sinner. These are her words: "Don't worry about him using his power. That man's special ability is the guarantee of his loyalty."

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: I don't know what that means exactly, but it's obvious that you've been avoiding using your special ability.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: Your position may be precarious, so we won't delve into it. The FAC simply wants to locate ${PlayerName} as soon as possible. If you know something, please tell us. To fight against the Black Ring, we need that Chief's power.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Hasn't Paradeisos already set out for the search? Why does the FAC have to come to me so urgently... What's the rush?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Is it because Paradeisos is really preparing for the Purge Order? To prevent the millions from West District from becoming food for the Black Ring and falling into the hands of the Underground?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: That's what the Executive Committee's stupid population management work is for, isn't it?

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: We won't ask for your trust, and we know that most people in West District don't trust us. That's okay, that's not the FAC's purpose.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: We only have one purpose, and it's...

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: I know, I know. It's "to fight against Mania and protect the ordinary people." And I never said I don't trust you guys.
Donald waves his hand to interrupt the soldier.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Your boss's got balls to dare bypass the Executive Committee and come to a shady character like me behind Paradeisos's back. He almost got assassinated in August for building the blockade line to protect West District too, didn't he?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: It's people like you who keep the fantasy of the city-state alive...

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Anyway, enough of that. I've only spoken to that ${PlayerName} once. Hush would have taken him long ago if he'd been with me. I know your time is precious, so go do what needs to be done, and just trust him and wait for him to return.
steps.female_content: Anyway, enough of that. I've only spoken to that ${PlayerName} once. Hush would have taken her long ago if she'd been with me. I know your time is precious, so go do what needs to be done, and just trust her and wait for her to return.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Look, our appreciation seems to be mutual, so why don't we stop making things difficult for each other? We've all got business here. I won't just run away if you let me go. Here, take my number. I'm sure we'll meet again soon.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: ...Give us a reason to trust you.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Here's two for you. First, as long as you continue to protect the safety of innocent civilians, then regardless of our positions, we need each other. Soon enough, we'll be joining hands again. Your Commander-in-Chief knows this, that's why he sent you for me.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: ...And the second reason?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Well, the second reason is that... You can't catch up to me!
He raises his hand and a rope shoots out from his sleeve and pulls him up to a high place.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Since you can't bring yourself to shoot me, let's not waste any more time here. Get going, buddy! I'm an escape expert, few can catch me. See ya!
The FAC is skilled at dealing with Mania but not rogues like that, so they miss the golden chance in that brief moment of hesitation. Once they quickly come to their senses and try to pursue him...
An urgent message suddenly comes in. From a high-level anti-Mania communication channel, no less.

steps.speaker: Paradeisos
steps.content: Attention, this is an important message for the FAC and the 9th Agency's frontline squads.

steps.speaker: Paradeisos
steps.content: We have located the MBCC's Chief ${PlayerName} from verified intelligence. I repeat, the MBCC's Chief has been located.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: They've found that Chief?
Someone's head suddenly leans onto him.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Where?

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: Didn't you run off?
Donald waves his hand to signal him to be quiet, his eyes more focused and tense than ever.

steps.speaker: Paradeisos
steps.content: The vanguard has already set out for rescue. Several Sinners are confirmed to be present at the location. Enemy forces are suspected to have taken the MBCC's Chief ${PlayerName} and are threatening the city-state's security. Notify all nearby combat units to get ready to aid the mission anytime.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: Phew... That's good news. With ${PlayerName} here, there's still hope we can defeat this Black Ring.
Donald furrows his eyebrows.

Protect ${PlayerName}? What a joke. If they'd truly cared about him, they wouldn't have used his death to their advantage! Before the Garden came, Paradeisos had always been the biggest threat to ${PlayerName}.
steps.female_content: Protect ${PlayerName}? What a joke. If they'd truly cared about her, they wouldn't have used her death to their advantage! Before the Garden came, Paradeisos had always been the biggest threat to ${PlayerName}.

steps.content: Moreover, with them present, Paradeisos couldn't possibly find ${PlayerName}, nor would they go to such a place...
steps.female_content: Moreover, with them present, Paradeisos couldn't possibly find ${PlayerName}, nor would they go to such a place...

steps.content: As he thinks that, he poses a different question.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: ...Has Paradeisos found him? Where is he? We should go help them immediately.
steps.female_content: ...Has Paradeisos found her? Where is she? We should go help them immediately.

steps.speaker: Paradeisos
steps.content: The specific location is...
Upon hearing the location, Donald's eyes widen.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: No, not there. Paradeisos didn't find ${PlayerName}. This is false information!

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Who tipped them off, and for what purpose... The person deceiving Paradeisos is...

steps.speaker: Figure in Shadow
steps.content: I'm not joking with you, take him away immediately. An Undergrounder came here a week ago and I made him bloom. That Undergrounder carried a special sorcery on his body to mark his own death, all for tracking ${PlayerName} down. I think the location's been exposed.
steps.female_content: I'm not joking with you, take her away immediately. An Undergrounder came here a week ago and I made him bloom. That Undergrounder carried a special sorcery on his body to mark his own death, all for tracking ${PlayerName} down. I think the location's been exposed.

steps.speaker: Figure in Shadow
steps.content: But since then... the Underground hasn't sent anyone else. Something must be going on. You guys be careful.
A bad premonition hits him suddenly. Donald whips his head around to find Parma slowly rotting on the ground.
It's the Underground who found ${PlayerName}. They saw ${PlayerName} and didn't kill him, but they probably got his biometrics.
steps.female_content: It's the Underground who found ${PlayerName}. They saw ${PlayerName} and didn't kill her, but they probably got her biometrics.

steps.content: Then they used it to mislead Paradeisos. The Underground knows Paradeisos needs ${PlayerName} and would stop at nothing to acquire him. But the Underground gave them false information to lead them to the most densely populated refugee base. That means the Underground has only one goal...
steps.female_content: Then they used it to mislead Paradeisos. The Underground knows Paradeisos needs ${PlayerName} and would stop at nothing to acquire her. But the Underground gave them false information to lead them to the most densely populated refugee base. That means the Underground has only one goal...

steps.content: The "person" lying on the ground lets out a weak laugh. His body is decaying and his lifeless eyes look like they're staring at both Donald and some distant figures.

steps.speaker: Parma
steps.content: You guys did a pretty good job manipulating others last time. What makes you so slow this time?

steps.speaker: Parma
steps.content: Is that Hush gone? Has West District's collective observation ended? Hehehe...

steps.speaker: Parma
steps.content: Well then, we'll be going first...
A roar comes from atop the maze walls.
Stop listening to him, run! You want the Black Ring to devour you?
That man is just a decoy. The Black Ring is all charged up. It's about to explode! Go!

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: ...Damn it.

The dots are all connected now. This is Paradeisos. This is the Underground. Donald once thought he could trick both sides and find a way out for ${PlayerName} and West District. But now it seems... he's underestimated those bastards.
At the refugee base, the Paradeisian troops stand in a line. Their faces are armored, but still, their cold, scrutinizing gazes pierce through.
In front of them, a hovering obsidian object speaks for the elite soldiers.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Greetings, unregistered inhabitants of West District. I am here on behalf of Paradeisos to investigate the whereabouts of a city-state official.

steps.speaker: Matilda
steps.content: Paradeisos...?!

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Our time is very limited. Please answer all my questions honestly.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Are you holding the MBCC's Chief ${PlayerName} hostage?
